## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 23 user-facing changes.
### New
- Passwords can make one-time codes. Set one up from the site's QR code, a pasted key or link, an image, or the iPhone camera, and Crest offers the live code in the code field, across split fields too. - Crest fills addresses and payment cards into whole forms, menus included, and offers to save new ones you send. They're shared by every Space, and a card fills only after Touch ID or your device password. - On sites that ask for your email or username first, choosing an account fills its password on the next page as soon as it appears. - Settings › Autofill › Passwords has Add Password, for a password you type in yourself, with a strong password one click away.
### Improved
- Password files carry notes and one-time code links when you import or export them, and an import says which column made a row fail. - When a password manager extension handles passwords in a Space, Crest leaves passwords and codes to it and says so once. Addresses and cards still fill. - The engine's own password, payment and address settings pages open Settings › Autofill instead. - Clicking anywhere on the page outside the field closes Crest's passwords popup. - Saved passwords show each site's own icon in Settings and in the popup, fetched once from the site itself when Crest hasn't seen it yet.
### Fixed
- Logins saved for an IP address written another way, such as 127.1, fill again. - On Chromium pages, only Crest offers to save and fill passwords, even if the engine's own password setting was turned back on. - On Chromium pages, suggestions point at sign-in fields inside a frame from another site, and follow the page as it scrolls.

## Highlights
### Improved
- Search fields in Settings, the sidebar's lists, folder previews and the icon and symbol pickers share one look, show a focus ring while you type, and have a clear button that highlights under the pointer. - The developer toolbar's buttons, the extension side panel's close button and the engine choices in Settings highlight under the pointer like Crest's other controls, and disclosure arrows in site settings and Privacy point the right way in right-to-left languages. - The sidebar's update and Now Playing cards, the translation bar and the symbol and emoji pickers use Crest's standard buttons, with the same hover and press highlights as the rest of Crest. - Reviewing a password import shows the Space's crest and lays the totals, accounts, warnings and rejected rows out in Settings-style groups, with each row number tagged in its warning or error colour. - Renaming a Space in place shows Crest's field with a focus ring, and its pencil highlights under the pointer. - Link routes in Settings sit directly in their group instead of a box inside it, the URL pattern uses Crest's field with a focus ring, and the route actions button highlights under the pointer.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
